pr_body:
This change fixes the engine to apply the current codec when retrieving documents from the translog. We need to use the same codec than the main index in order to ensure that all the source data is indexable. The internal codec treats some fields differently, for instance dense_vectors are limited to 1024 dimensions in the default codec. This PR ensures that these customisations are applied when indexing document for translog retrieval.

Closes #104639
pr_title: Get from translog fails with large dense_vector

review_comment: It would be nice to also validate that we can read out the right dense vector value, though with the way it is implemented, it should hardly be an issue.

The test already checks that the retrieved source is identical: [source](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/d0263411cee3f258c4de7b5437c6b5149d24910b/server/src/test/java/org/elasticsearch/index/shard/ShardGetServiceTests.java#L187)
Do you think it's not enough?
